sample_mapping: GetBuffer failure calls neither Render nor Submitted, so neither attempted-frame counter advances
Normal admitted stereo callback calls Render then Submitted; both advance by the same attempted frame count
ReleaseBuffer failure advances both counters but skips analysis admission and physical presentation is unknown
Queue drop or failed submission marks next admitted block discontinuous; absolute submitted positions remain
record_window: center_frame is first frame of physical RMS interval [center_frame,center_frame+valid_frames), not geometric center or displayed edge

dsp.timing: fixed processing sample offset, not device or acoustic latency

limits: RMS spans up to480 frames/10ms; threshold transition does not identify exact waveform onset
Mask11 spectrum adds publication lookahead; Flutter polling/paint further delay display
Generated gate edge may begin with a zero-valued sine sample; no assertion of acoustic onset at gate edge
Source/Submitted equality is source invariant under admitted stereo path, not separately observed physical-clock correlation
No physical recording/calibrated phone A/V offset/source-to-photon proof
